steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen used by the case.
Set the event type to RFQ.
Provide the mandatory event title required for publishing.
Apply the first available RFQ template so the pricing sheet can be populated.
Add the specified product and quantity; the product's mapped Variant 1 is selected by the product flow.
Complete the remaining required pricing-sheet fields before publishing.
Set the requested delivery location on the first line item.

args.goal: open the Terms & Conditions control, enter "QA clause" in the Add your own terms & conditions field, add the clause, press Done, and stop on the buyer create screen showing the clause listed

steps.note: Perform the custom-clause modal interaction and verify the clause is listed on the buyer screen.
Commit a valid event schedule required for publishing.
Invite one QA test vendor so the published event can be checked from the vendor portal.
Confirm that publishing reached a real event page.
Move to the invited vendor's supplier-portal session.
Open the event overview where the vendor's visible terms can be inspected.
Verify that the vendor can see the buyer-defined clause.
